**Commit:** `9a223c77`

**Revised cases and reasons:**

| # | Case | File | Reason |
|---|------|------|--------|
| 1 | `test_doctor_is_a_read_command` | `test_w1_27_doctor.py` | Revised after implementation: doctor verifies every registry entry under the session's home (DEC-452); the case built its healthy project from this repository's registry and so depended on the real machine. Now builds its own registry with a fake binary tool under `tmp_path` and properly verifies the working tree is unchanged via snapshot comparison. |
| 2 | `test_doctor_envelope_is_valid_on_healthy_project` | `test_w1_27_doctor.py` | Same reason. Now writes a custom registry with a single fake tool that passes, alongside a valid path map, and asserts `ok=true`, exit 0. |
| 3 | `test_minimal_kernel_passes_at_minimal_level` | `test_w1_27_adoption.py` | Same reason. Now replaces the copied registry with a single fake tool before running doctor. |
| 4 | `test_completed_stages_raise_adoption_level` | `test_w1_27_adoption.py` | Same reason. Previously passed vacuously (tools failed under sandbox home → `result` was empty → no keyword matched → test checked nothing). Now replaces the registry with fake tools and extracts the adoption level from either `result` or `error.details`. |

**Machine-dependent case added:** `test_doctor_real_registry_every_entry_reported` — runs doctor against the real registry with the real home; asserts every registry entry is listed by name (tools in the `tools` section, `claude code` in its own `claude_code` section), and each entry has `ok` plus fields showing how it passed or why it didn't. Does not assert the machine is healthy.

**Counts:** 106 passed, 1 failed in 152s.

**Remaining failure:** `test_rebuild_codeintel_is_recreated_when_tool_answers` (`test_w1_27_rebuild_r4.py`) — this is the known sandbox-dependent case. The code index tool (`codebase-memory-mcp`) attempts to write to `/tmp/gov-cbm-1000/` which the test sandbox blocks with `[Errno 30] Read-only file system`. The test is already marked `@pytest.mark.local_only`; it passes outside the sandbox where `/tmp` is writable.
